posts.name: chwineka
posts.cooked:
So my amazing friend Greonhal picked up my SotM stuff while at PAX, and on Monday he brought it over and the Great Sleeving began. As that was going on, the two of us noticed something... weird. Something I haven't seen anyone else talk about on the forum.

One of the wrapped set of cards in my Enhanced Edition was smaller than all of the other cards. About half of Ra's cards, all of Tachyon's, and about a third of Tempest's are all about a milimeter smaller than every other card in the set. With sleeves it's not quite as noticible, but it's still rather strange, especially since Greonhal was certain his cards weren't like that.

It's not a huge issue, but if it happened once it may happen again. So... anyone else noticed anything like this?

posts.name: Smilinbrax
posts.cooked:
I think what we have here is bad die cutting. All my cards have varying degrees of off center cuts. Nothing is miscut to the point of needing replacement. My enhanced edition environment cards all suffer from the too big syndrome. I noticed when they were are to put into sleeves and filled them to the top. All the other decks had extra sleeve space a the top. I sleeve my cards so this is not a problem. 

My question is how his coud happen logistically. I assume the dies are sized before running cards throughout the cutter. So how could the sizes differ? Do they move during the cutting process? Or do they have to recalibrate every so often? Very strange but nothing I'm going to write in for.

I am going to be asking for two replacement cards though. About 1 in a 100 cards stuck together in my set. One pair of omnitron's stuck so well that separating resulted in tears to the front of one and the back of another. I'll send an email with pictures as the back of the card is dearly marked and it is sedative fleschettes which is devastating and not one you what to be able to plan for.

posts.name: VanceAttack
posts.cooked:
I'd recommend that if you're having trouble shuffling to do it in a different way. The method I use to shuffle my cards is that I take the deck and deal it into 5 - 7 piles and pick them up randomly (if that makes sense). Pretty much it's the way you would have to shuffle the cards if you had put sleeves on them. I make sure that anyone using my cards does this as well since it protects the cards from any excess force that someone may use in riffling and any bend that may occur. 

As far as their response time in responding to emails, I think that it may take a while. Just imagine that every single enhanced edition that they sent out has this problem. That means that everyone who received a copy is going to send an email on the issue.

I can only assume this, but they're probably working with the printing company to have those decks reprinted. Once they have some sort of news on this I'm sure they will announce it.
